title: Snagbox
description: Snagbox is an open-source, self-hostable API that downloads video and audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and more with one request.
excerpt: Snagbox is an open-source, self-hostable API that downloads video and audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and more with one request.
body:
## Overview

I built Snagbox, an open-source, self-hostable API that turns a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and more into a clean download. Paste a URL, pick video or audio and a quality, and get a file back.

## Challenge

Most downloaders are ad-filled websites or fragile scripts. I wanted a real API that developers can run on their own server, with proper auth, queues and limits instead of a single shell command.

## What I shipped

- A NestJS 11 API on yt-dlp and ffmpeg with platform plugins and an optional generic mode
- A job queue with live progress events, batch and playlist downloads, and signed expiring file links
- API keys, rate limiting, an SSRF guard and HMAC-signed webhooks
- Local or S3/R2 storage, Prometheus metrics, OpenAPI docs and a built-in playground
- A one-command Docker setup and a published image on GHCR

## Result

Snagbox v2.0.0 is open source on GitHub with a live playground. Anyone can self-host it with Docker and plug it into their own apps.

## Links

- Live playground: https://snagbox.fabwaseem.com
- Source code: https://github.com/fabwaseem/snagbox
- v2.0.0 release: https://github.com/fabwaseem/snagbox/releases/tag/v2.0.0

excerpt: Cladly is a modern web app built with Next.js, designed to deliver a smooth user experience for managing content and user workflows.
body:
## Overview

I built Cladly as a Next.js web application focused on delivering a clean, responsive interface for content management and user onboarding flows. It supports secure authentication and smooth navigation between protected and public pages.

## Challenge

The main challenge was to create a user-friendly platform that handles authentication states gracefully while maintaining fast performance and security.

## What I shipped

- Implemented route protection to redirect users based on their authentication status, improving user flow.
- Integrated modern React hooks and libraries for form handling, drag-and-drop, and animations to enhance interactivity.
- Set up a secure content security policy and HTTP headers to protect user data and comply with best practices.
- Designed the app with optimized fonts and responsive layouts for a polished look on all devices.
- Used Prisma for database migrations and schema management, ensuring data integrity.

## Result

Cladly offers a smooth, secure experience for users managing content and profiles. It balances modern UI with solid backend practices to keep users engaged and safe.

title: Vidyoza
description: Vidyoza is a social media video downloader that helps users save videos and audio from major platforms in multiple formats and qualities.
excerpt: Vidyoza is a social media video downloader that helps users save videos and audio from major platforms in multiple formats and qualities.
body:
## Overview

I built Vidyoza, a social media video downloader that supports YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, and Facebook. It lets users save videos in resolutions from 4K down to 144p, and extract audio in popular formats with cover art.

## Challenge

Downloading videos from multiple platforms with flexible quality and format options while keeping the experience smooth and secure.

## What I shipped

- A NestJS API engine that handles downloads with live progress updates and supports cancellation
- A Next.js frontend with animated, user-friendly interfaces for pasting links, selecting formats, and managing download history
- Support for video containers like MP4, MKV, WebM, plus audio extraction to MP3, M4A, OPUS, WAV, and FLAC
- Per-platform pages optimized for SEO with static generation and sitemap integration
- Security features including API key controls, rate limiting, and safe file serving

## Result

Vidyoza offers a polished, full-featured downloader that works across major social platforms. It balances rich functionality with a smooth user experience and strong security safeguards.

title: Banowi AI Commerce Agent
description: An AI sales assistant for Shopify merchants in Pakistan, handling customer chats on WhatsApp with real-time product and order insights.
excerpt: An AI sales assistant for Shopify merchants in Pakistan, handling customer chats on WhatsApp with real-time product and order insights.
body:
## Overview

I built Banowi AI Commerce Agent to act as a smart sales employee for Shopify stores in Pakistan, working directly through WhatsApp. It's not just a chatbot, it reasons with real data from Shopify and a knowledge base to answer customer questions accurately and quickly.

## Challenge

Shopify merchants needed a way to handle WhatsApp sales chats that reflect live inventory, pricing, and order status without manual updates or errors.

## What I shipped

- A real-time sync system that mirrors Shopify store data into a database using webhooks, ensuring up-to-date product and order info.
- An AI agent that processes WhatsApp messages, reasons over multiple data sources, and responds with precise answers or escalates to humans.
- A dashboard for merchants to monitor conversations, manage orders, review payments, and track AI decisions.

## Result

Merchants get a reliable AI assistant that remembers customers and handles complex sales questions on WhatsApp, improving engagement without extra staff.

title: Sonora
description: Sonora is a private, fully offline speech studio for Windows that offers text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and global dictation.
excerpt: Sonora is a private, fully offline speech studio for Windows that offers text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and global dictation.
body:
## Overview

I built Sonora, a Windows desktop app that lets you create and transcribe speech entirely offline. It combines text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and global voice typing into one local studio.

## Challenge

Many speech tools send your data to the cloud, risking privacy and requiring internet. I wanted to keep everything on your PC with no external servers involved.

## What I shipped

- A native app with a sleek studio UI for managing voices and dictation
- Global dictation that types into any app using a hotkey and live streaming
- First-run setup that installs a private Python runtime and downloads speech models
- Local multi-engine speech processing with offline TTS and STT
- Automatic signed updates and a public landing site to showcase the product

## Result

Sonora lets users work with speech privately and securely on Windows. It supports natural voice creation, transcription, and dictation without cloud dependencies.
metaDescription: Sonora is a private, fully offline speech studio for Windows that offers text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and global dictation.

title: Snipshot
description: Snipshot is a Windows screenshot tool that helps users capture, annotate, and export polished images quickly.
excerpt: Snipshot is a Windows screenshot tool that helps users capture, annotate, and export polished images quickly.
body:
## Overview

I built Snipshot, a desktop screenshot studio for Windows that lets users capture any screen, region, or window, then frame and annotate the shot with ease. It's designed to speed up the process of turning raw screenshots into share-ready visuals.

## Challenge

Users needed a fast, flexible tool to capture screenshots with rich annotation and export options, all without leaving their desktop.

## What I shipped

- Multiple capture modes including fullscreen, region, and window selection with multi-monitor support
- Annotation tools like shapes, arrows, text, and spotlight with styling controls
- Various framing mockups, backgrounds, and export formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP) with scaling and quick-save
- Tray integration and global hotkeys for instant capture
- A modern, responsive landing page showcasing features and downloads

## Result

Snipshot offers a streamlined way to capture and enhance screenshots on Windows. It stays out of the way in the system tray and supports quick workflows with hotkeys and auto-copy features.
metaDescription: Snipshot is a Windows screenshot tool that helps users capture, annotate, and export polished images quickly.

title: Lumina
description: Lumina is a cross-platform Electron gallery that browses CivitAI and queues prompts into a local ComfyUI server with workflow mapping and LoRA downloads.
excerpt: Lumina is a cross-platform Electron gallery that browses CivitAI and queues prompts into a local ComfyUI server with workflow mapping and LoRA downloads.
body:
## Overview

I built Lumina, a cross-platform Electron desktop gallery for browsing CivitAI images and sending their prompts into a local ComfyUI server. It uses an uploaded, mapped API workflow, so a selected post can queue a generation without dragging files onto the ComfyUI canvas.

## Challenge

Browsing CivitAI and regenerating a look in ComfyUI usually means copying prompts by hand, hunting missing LoRAs, and juggling downloads. I wanted a desktop app that keeps the gallery, prompt metadata, LoRA checks, and ComfyUI queue in one place, on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## What I shipped

- A frameless Electron 40 app with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS 4
- Virtualized masonry, grid, and list views with search, base-model, period, and sort filters
- A lightbox with prompt, negative prompt, sampler metadata, and resources
- Prompt send into a running local ComfyUI server through an API workflow you upload and map yourself
- Missing-LoRA detection with downloads into the ComfyUI `models/loras` folder
- A download manager with pause, resume, retry, and a concurrency limit
- Light and dark themes, local image save, and CI plus tag-based releases for Windows, macOS, and Linux installers

## Result

Lumina is open source on GitHub with a v1.0.0 release that ships Windows, macOS, and Linux installers. Artists can browse CivitAI, fill missing LoRAs, and queue prompts into their own ComfyUI from one desktop app.

## Links

- Source code: https://github.com/fabwaseem/lumina
- Releases: https://github.com/fabwaseem/lumina/releases
- v1.0.0 release: https://github.com/fabwaseem/lumina/releases/tag/v1.0.0

title: NovaCraft UI
description: NovaCraft UI is a dark-first React component library with glass and glow effects, live theming, blocks and templates.
excerpt: NovaCraft UI is a dark-first React component library with glass and glow effects, live theming, blocks and templates.
body:
## Overview

I built NovaCraft UI, a dark-first React component library with a full documentation site. It gives developers copy-paste primitives with glass, glow and gradient treatments that they can theme with CSS variables.

## Challenge

Most component libraries look the same and fight you when you want a bolder, futuristic look. I wanted a set that is striking by default, stays accessible, and has no package lock-in.

## What I shipped

- 54 documented, typed components, from form inputs to overlays, data display and navigation
- Glass, glow, gradient and soft variants on the same primitives
- A theme playground where colors, radius, type and effects are live CSS variables
- Ready-made blocks and full-page templates built from the primitives
- Keyboard support, labeled controls, visible focus and a light theme one toggle away

## Result

NovaCraft UI is open source with a live docs site. Developers can browse every component, tune a theme, and drop the code straight into their own apps.

## Links

- Live docs: https://novacraft-ui.vercel.app
- Source code: https://github.com/fabwaseem/novacraft-ui
